name: Singapore Institute of Technology
summary: Applied-learning university in Punggol with about 40 degrees, many with an 8 to 12 month industry placement and some joint with overseas partners.

ib.text: Needs the IB Diploma with grade 5 in at least two HL subjects and one SL subject; May sitters apply on forecast results. Some degrees add English, maths, medical or portfolio conditions.

programmes.name: Diagnostic Radiography
programmes.about: A four-year direct honours degree that trains you to produce and interpret medical images (X-ray, CT, MRI, ultrasound, nuclear medicine), with at least 1,000 hours of clinical placements.
programmes.ib: English: SL English A Language and Literature, or Literature and Performance, at grade 4 (or an IELTS 6.0 or TOEFL score). Medical clearance is mandatory.
programmes.selectionNote: Grade 5 in two HL and one SL subject, then an interview or written test for those shortlisted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

flagshipSource.title: SIT Diagnostic Radiography: accredited by the Allied Health Professions Council

programmes.name: Food Technology
programmes.credential: Bachelor of Food Technology with Honours
programmes.about: A four-year direct honours degree that joins food science, food engineering, design and business, with lab work on industrial food-processing equipment and an 8 to 12 month work placement.
programmes.selectionNote: Grade 5 in two HL and one SL subject, then an interview or written test for those shortlisted. 2026 criteria; 2027 not yet published.

flagshipSource.title: SIT Food Technology: industry-built curriculum with lab work on industrial equipment

faculties.name: Allied Health
faculties.line: Radiography, therapy, dietetics: set English levels (IB SL English A grade 4) and mandatory medical clearance.

faculties.name: Nursing
faculties.line: Nursing degrees follow the general IB rule; mandatory medical clearance applies to health sciences.

faculties.name: Information and Digital Technology
faculties.line: The DigiPen computer science degrees want HL Maths, Physics or Computing, or SL Maths; others follow the general IB rule.

faculties.name: Electrical and Electronics Engineering
faculties.line: No set IB subjects are listed; the TUM degree follows German recognition rules (HL Maths, three HL subjects).

faculties.name: Mechanical Engineering
faculties.line: SIT, Glasgow and Newcastle degrees follow the general IB rule; no extra subjects are listed.

faculties.name: Business and Management
faculties.line: Accountancy and Business and Infocomm Technology follow the general rule; Hospitality and Tourism adds its own requirements.

faculties.name: Design and Media
faculties.line: Communication and Digital Media has English conditions; DigiPen Digital Art and Animation needs a 10 to 15 piece portfolio.

notes: EU students can take the MOE Tuition Grant, which cuts the fee but requires you to work for a Singapore entity for three years after graduating.
Degrees are SIT-conferred, joint with a partner, or conferred by the partner alone (Glasgow, Newcastle, TUM, DigiPen, the Culinary Institute of America), so check who awards yours.
Every shortlisted applicant is interviewed or tested, in varying formats; some degrees also ask for a portfolio or essay.
